content:
rachael: Heads-up — rolling rwd-supermodel v3.1.0 tonight in a geo-phased deploy. Window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Sequence: US (canary -> full) -> EU (canary -> full) -> APAC (canary -> full). Pin routes to 3.1.0 during rollout.

rachael: Roll slices: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m observation between steps.

devon: +1. Add health-check gating: error_rate > 4% or p99 latency delta > 180ms triggers automated rollback.

maria: Capacity readout: US warm pool 128 GPUs idle, EU warm pool 36 GPUs idle, APAC warm pool 28 GPUs idle. EU buffer low — prefer smaller initial canary (5%).

sam: Noted. We'll cap EU canary at 5% and hold for 20m before next step. APAC keep conservative too.

jordan: Product note — metrics consumer tests queued. Will post pass/fail in-thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduling rollout job id=roll-2798765432
deploy-bot: Command queued:
```
/deploy start --service=rwd-supermodel --version=3.1.0 --regions=us,eu,apac --slices=5,25,60,100 --stagger=10m --pin=true
```

deponly: tagging release notes draft: "3.1.0 — latency optimizations, kv-cache fix" (will attach to release once canary passes).

devon: Oncall checklist:
- Smoke: /health check /predict on 3 scenarios
- Trace sample enabled for 2% of requests
- Alert thresholds: error_rate > 4% (5m), p99+delta > 180ms (5m)

rachael: @deploy-bot please insert a manual holdpoint after EU canary.

deploy-bot: Holdpoint created after EU canary (step 2). Manual resume required: `/deploy resume roll-2798765432`

sam: Running quick capacity sanity:
```
# quick kpi qs
US: reserved=400 active=272 warm=128
EU: reserved=180 active=144 warm=36
APAC: reserved=120 active=92 warm=28
```

maria: If EU warm drops below 25 GPUs during canary, abort and fallback to pinned 3.0.x variant.

jordan: QA smoke tests queued, ETA 12m after canary. Will comment PASS/FAIL.

devon: Adding a rollback playbook here: short circuit if error_rate > 4% OR p99 delta > 180ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows. Rollback steps: 1) pin traffic to 3.0.x, 2) scale down new replicas, 3) notify #incidents and customers if >10% user impact.

rachael: Note: telemetry retention will be extended to 30m for this rollout so we can inspect traces quickly.

deploy-bot: roll-2798765432: US canary started (5% slice). Canary window: 10m.

maria: US canary smoke: success (0.6% error, p99 delta +12ms).

jordan: QA PASS on baseline tests.

sam: US canary metrics look clean. Proceeding to 25% in 10m.

deploy-bot: roll-2798765432: US -> 25% slice complete. Monitoring.

devon: Observability: increased trace sampling set, collecting p95/p99 by route.

maria: EU warm pool check before EU canary: current warm=36, predicted thermal headroom ~22. We'll keep EU canary at 5% and wait for manual resume.

rachael: Pausing for EU holdpoint. @sam @devon standby for resume.

deploy-bot: roll-2798765432: EU canary queued but held (manual).

jordan: QA will target EU canary region as soon as resumed.

devon: Reminder — fallback model variant available: 3.0.7-quant for lower memory footprint. Rollback will pin to that if capacity signals worsen.

sam: If EU error spikes, immediate rollback + notify. Also tagging this deploy with ops-ticket #OPS-9142.

rachael: I'll resume when EU smoke signals arrive green.

maria: EU smoke now: synthetic checks show 1.2% error, p99 delta +25ms. Good to go.

rachael: Resuming EU canary now.

deploy-bot: `/deploy resume roll-2798765432` -> EU canary executing (5%).

jordan: QA started EU tests. Will update within 15m.

devon: Watching alerts. No anomalies so far.

maria: APAC warm pool still low but tolerable for small canary. We'll sequence APAC after EU full.

deploy-bot: roll-2798765432: EU canary -> EU 25% after manual approval. Monitoring windows set.

jordan: EU QA PASS. No regressions in downstream scoring.

sam: EU metrics stable. Proceed to EU full (60% -> 100% according to slice plan).

deploy-bot: roll-2798765432: EU -> 60% -> 100% complete.

rachael: Great. Preparing APAC canary in 30m. Final checks: docs updated, release notes linked, support on standby.

maria: APAC warm pool trending up to 34 GPUs in 20m due to scheduled replenishment. We'll start APAC canary after that window.

devon: All monitoring signals green. No rollback.

rachael: Thanks team. Will keep thread updated if anything noisy. If you see alerts, escalate to #incidents immediately. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: roll-2798765432: rollout complete — all regions at 3.1.0. No automated rollback triggered. Logs: /deploy/logs/roll-2798765432

rachael: Postmortem note: capture a short blip at US 23:07 UTC where p95 spiked +55ms for 2m; not user impacting but will track in next sprint."
